effect.shortEffect: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.
effect.full: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

french.sv: Quand le soleil brille ou que le Pokémon tient\nune capsule d’Énergie Booster, sa stat la plus élevée\naugmente.

english.sv: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

japanese.sv: ブーストエナジーを　持たせるか 天気が　晴れのとき いちばん　高い能力が　上がる。
